editorial.blurb: A hidden gem where Chef Tim and his wife pour heart and dedication into every roll, delivering pristine fish and house-made sauces that justify the drive.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the ocean ceviche and let the owner (who's often serving) guide you—regulars swear by the Sushi B and crunchy spicy tuna, and the attention to detail (like deveining shrimp) shows they're not cutting corners.
